items.title: 華爾街最強策略神話破滅？美股動量交易恐迎25年來最慘烈單季潰敗
items.title_en: Has Wall Street's Most Powerful Strategy Myth Crumbled? U.S. Momentum Trading Faces Its Worst Quarterly Collapse in 25 Years
paras: 華爾街今年最火熱的「動量交易」(Momentum Trading)策略，正面臨一場極為慘烈的逆轉。長期以來被奉為致富準則的「買入領漲股、做空掉隊者」強者恆強邏輯正在迅速瓦解。
自7月1日以來，標普500動量指數已重挫逾9%，而同期標普500大盤仍上漲2.8%，兩者之間巨大的背離，預示著動量指數正走向25年來最嚴重的單季下挫。
動量策略在今年上半年隨著AI浪潮達到顛峰，投資人瘋狂湧入輝達(NVDA-US)、美光(MU-US)和AMD(AMD-US)等明星股，並大舉做空可能被AI邊緣化的企業。標普500動量指數在第二季飆升44%，創下史上最佳單季表現，過去5年的累計回報高達133%，幾乎是大盤的兩倍。
然而，下半年的逆轉極其迅速且殘酷。美國銀行數據指出，今年7月是動量交易近40年來表現第二差的月份，慘烈程度僅次於2009年金融危機期間的至暗時刻。高盛數據也顯示，避險基金最集中的多頭持股在7月份的表現，落後大盤幅度創下20多年來新高。
其中，8月19日更成為系統性多空經理人兩年來最痛苦的一天，其中約半數虧損直接源於動量交易的失效。
這場擁擠交易的引爆點，來自長期被集體做空的生技類股。莫德納(MRNA-US)與默沙東(MRK-US)合作研發的癌症疫苗傳出臨床利好消息，促使莫德納股價單月暴漲約150%。這迫使重倉做空這一產業的量化避險基金遭遇強烈空頭回補，引發慘重損失。
與此同時，被譽為「AI概念股低語者」的避險基金「Situational Awareness」也因過度押注半導體等動量股而慘遭洗盤並面臨崩潰。市場情緒的劇變，促使商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)數據中的那斯達克100指數期貨投機性淨空頭頭寸，攀升至近20年來的最高點。
面對這波市場暗流，部分基金經理人已轉趨謹慎。奧格本資本管理(Ogborne Capital Management)創辦人Mike Ogborne表示，他已收縮科技股部位並增加現金，對科技巨頭持續攀升的資本支出感到不安。他形容這就像「灰姑娘的午夜鐘聲」，沒人會提前通知這場資本狂歡何時結束。
儘管如此，AQR資本等長期擁護者仍對這一策略保持信心，認為歷史上最差的月份，往往出現在更長的超額收益周期中。
paras_en: Wall Street's hottest "Momentum Trading" strategy this year is facing an extremely severe reversal. The long‑held wealth‑building rule of "buy the leaders, short the laggards"—the strong stay strong logic—is rapidly disintegrating.

Since July 1, the S&P 500 Momentum Index has plunged more than 9%, while the broader S&P 500 index has risen 2.8% over the same period. The huge divergence between the two signals that the momentum index is heading for its steepest single‑quarter drop in 25 years.

Momentum strategies peaked in the first half of the year alongside the AI wave, with investors flooding into star stocks such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Micron (MU‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US) and heavily shorting firms that might be sidelined by AI. The S&P 500 Momentum Index surged 44% in Q2, delivering its best quarterly performance ever, and has generated a cumulative 133% return over the past five years—almost twice the market’s gain.

However, the reversal in the second half has been swift and brutal. U.S. bank data shows July was the second‑worst month for momentum trading in nearly four decades, only eclipsed by the darkest period of the 2009 financial crisis. Goldman Sachs data also indicates that the most concentrated long positions held by hedge funds lagged the market by a margin that set a new 20‑year high in July.
August 19 turned into the most painful day for systematic long‑short managers in two years, with roughly half of the losses directly stemming from the failure of momentum trades.

The trigger for this crowded trade came from biotech stocks that had been collectively shorted for a long time. A positive clinical development on a cancer vaccine co‑developed by Moderna (MRNA‑US) and Merck (MRK‑US) sent Moderna’s share price soaring about 150% in a single month, forcing quantitative hedge funds with large short positions in the sector into a fierce short‑covering rally and heavy losses.

At the same time, the hedge fund “Situational Awareness,” dubbed the "whisperer of AI concept stocks," was battered and on the brink of collapse after over‑betting on semiconductor and other momentum stocks. The market’s mood swing pushed speculative net‑short positions in Nasdaq‑100 futures, as reported by CFTC data, up to their highest level in nearly two decades.

Facing this market undercurrent, some fund managers have become more cautious. Mike Ogborne, founder of Ogborne Capital Management, said he has trimmed his tech holdings and added cash, uneasy about the continued rise in capital expenditures by tech giants. He likened it to "Cinderella’s midnight bell," noting that no one gets advance notice of when this capital‑spending frenzy will end.
Nevertheless, long‑time proponents such as AQR Capital still have confidence in the strategy, arguing that the historically worst months usually occur within longer cycles of excess returns.

items.title: 《紐時》砸2000萬美元告OpenAI、微軟！AI時代新聞版權與記者未來會如何？
paras: 人工智慧（AI）快速滲透新聞產業之際，《紐約時報》與OpenAI、微軟(MSFT-US) 的著作權訴訟，也逐漸從單一法律案件，演變成科技公司如何取得新聞內容、媒體如何維持商業模式的產業戰爭。
截至2026年7月底，《紐約時報》已為訴訟投入超過2000萬美元費用，但案件仍未完成證據開示程序。若持續訴訟，總成本可能攀升至4000萬美元。
對多數新聞機構而言，這筆金額足以支撐一家編輯部運作多年，但《紐約時報》並沒有停戰的打算。
《紐約時報》發行人蘇茲伯格（A.G. Sulzberger）認為，這場訴訟爭論的並不只是《紐約時報》能否獲得賠償，而是科技公司是否可以先取得新聞機構多年投入大量人力與資源製作的內容，再以「技術創新」為由決定是否付費，以及應該支付多少。
他強調，《紐約時報》並非反對AI，而是反對一種正在形成的商業模式：科技公司願意為人才、晶片、資料中心與電力支付高昂成本，卻把新聞、書籍、音樂與電影等內容統稱為可以免費取得的「資料」。

從談判破裂到對簿公堂

這場法律衝突最初並非始於法院。
2023年4月，《紐約時報》開始與OpenAI及微軟協商，希望針對新聞內容的使用方式達成協議。當時ChatGPT問世不到半年，出版業已逐漸意識到，生成式AI不只可能改變內容製作方式，也可能成為新聞網站的替代入口。
然而，雙方最終未能達成協議。
2023年12月27日，《紐約時報》向美國紐約南區聯邦地區法院正式起訴OpenAI與微軟，指控兩家公司未經授權複製數百萬篇《紐約時報》文章，用於訓練GPT系列大型語言模型，成為大型新聞機構首次同時將OpenAI與微軟告上法庭的案件。
《紐約時報》的指控主要集中在三個層面。
首先是模型訓練階段。該報認為，OpenAI在蒐集、整理並輸入訓練資料時複製其文章，而部分內容之後被模型「記住」，同樣可能構成未經授權的複製。
其次是模型輸出階段。《紐約時報》在訴狀中列舉包括紐約計程車牌照產業普立茲獎調查，以及《Snow Fall: The Avalanche at Tunnel Creek》（《雪崩：隧道溪事件》）等報導，主張ChatGPT能產生與原文高度相似、甚至接近逐字重現的內容。
微軟旗下Browse with Bing也遭到指控。該服務被指直接整理《紐約時報》旗下消費產品評測網站Wirecutter的推薦內容，保留推薦結果，卻未保留原文連結及可為Wirecutter帶來佣金收入的購物連結。
第三則是替代效應。
過去讀者通常透過搜尋引擎找到新聞，再點進《紐約時報》網站；如今ChatGPT與微軟Copilot可以直接提供答案，使用者可能不再造訪原始文章，使媒體面臨流量、訂閱、廣告及內容授權收入受到影響的風險。
《紐約時報》同時認為，AI生成錯誤資訊也可能被使用者誤認為來自該報，進而傷害新聞機構多年建立的品牌與公信力。
至於微軟，《紐約時報》並非因其投資OpenAI而將其一併列為被告。該公司向OpenAI提供資金與運算資源，並將相關模型整合至Bing搜尋、Copilot及Azure等產品。《紐約時報》因此認為，微軟既參與相關技術體系的建構，也利用模型推出商業服務，因此應承擔相應責任。
《紐約時報》並未提出具體索賠金額，但主張OpenAI與微軟可能須承擔數十億美元的法定賠償及實際損失，並要求銷毀包含其受著作權保護作品的訓練資料及相關模型。
若法院最終支持這項要求，影響將不只是賠償金額，更可能牽動整個AI產業取得訓練資料的方式。

《紐時》不是反AI　而是要求內容先取得授權

面對訴訟，OpenAI將《紐約時報》的行動形容為阻礙新技術發展。
OpenAI在2024年2月提交的文件中指控，《紐約時報》為取得訴狀中的模型重現結果，曾對ChatGPT進行數萬次嘗試，並透過文章片段與特殊提示詞誘導模型輸出。OpenAI認為，這並非一般使用者正常使用產品的方式。
微軟則將《紐約時報》對AI衝擊新聞業的描述形容為「末日式推演」，並以電影業過去反對錄影機的案例進行比喻，主張新技術雖然會改變內容消費方式，但不應因此直接被認定為侵權。
兩家公司抗辯的核心都是「合理使用」。
OpenAI與微軟認為，大型語言模型是在學習語言規律，而不是建立一個讓使用者搜尋原文的資料庫；模型偶爾重現文章，是技術上需要解決的問題，並不代表整個訓練行為違法。
但《紐約時報》並沒有選擇全面拒絕AI。蘇茲伯格表示，新聞機構沒有必要急著成為新技術的第一批使用者，更穩妥的方式是先觀察、學習與試驗，同時確保記者、編輯及新聞機構仍對最終內容負責。
《紐約時報》內部目前也將AI更多用於輔助採訪，而非直接取代記者完成寫作、編輯與發布。
例如，在一項針對加薩走廊彈坑的調查中，AI協助記者從數百萬張圖片中篩選出數千張可能具有價值的影像，但最終辨識、驗證與判斷仍由記者完成。參與報導的記者將AI形容為「過濾器」，可以縮小搜尋範圍，卻無法取代人類承擔新聞責任。
這也是蘇茲伯格對AI的核心立場：無論採用什麼工具，《紐約時報》發布的內容最終都必須由人負責。AI可以協助記者找到線索，但不應自行決定什麼是真相、什麼內容可以發布。

一邊打官司、一邊授權　《紐時》劃出合作紅線

《紐約時報》也並非拒絕與科技公司合作。
2025年5月，該報與亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 達成首份生成式AI內容授權協議。亞馬遜可以在Alexa等產品中展示《紐約時報》、NYT Cooking及《The Athletic》的內容摘要，也可以利用相關內容訓練自身基礎模型。
雙方沒有正式公布交易金額，但《華爾街日報》後續報導稱，亞馬遜每年支付的授權費約2000萬至2500萬美元。
這也形成一個值得注意的對比：《紐約時報》一方面已花費超過2000萬美元與OpenAI、微軟打官司，另一方面則透過授權協議，每年從亞馬遜取得大致相當規模的收入。
分析指出，兩者真正的差異並不在於是否使用AI，而在於是否事先取得授權，以及是否承認新聞內容具有價格。
2025年12月，《紐約時報》又對AI搜尋公司Perplexity提起訴訟，指控對方未經授權複製並展示包括付費文章在內的內容。
從這些行動可以看出，《紐約時報》正試圖為與矽谷的關係劃出界線：願意付費並接受授權條件的公司，可以成為合作夥伴；先使用內容、之後才協商的公司，則可能成為被告。

官司仍未定案　雙方爭奪證據成戰場

2025年4月4日，負責審理本案的美國聯邦地區Sidney H. Stein做出首項重要裁定。法院允許《紐約時報》的主要著作權訴求繼續推進，未接受OpenAI關於部分早期訓練行為已超過訴訟時效的主張，也沒有駁回與模型輸出及使用者複製相關的主要指控。
然而，這並不代表《紐約時報》已經勝訴。法院同時撤銷普通法不正當競爭及部分《數位千年著作權法》（DMCA）相關訴求。更重要的是，法官當時並未判定OpenAI訓練模型是否屬於合理使用，只認定《紐約時報》提出的核心事實足以進入證據開示階段。
此後，雙方開始圍繞證據展開攻防。2025年5月，法官一度要求OpenAI保存原本可能被刪除的ChatGPT輸出紀錄，包括使用者主動刪除的對話。OpenAI則認為，這可能違反其對使用者的隱私承諾。相關全面保存義務後來於2025年9月26日結束。
法院隨後要求OpenAI提供2022年12月至2024年11月期間隨機抽取的2000萬份ChatGPT對話，以判斷使用者是否曾透過ChatGPT複製《紐約時報》文章或繞過付費牆。
OpenAI已對這些對話進行去識別化，並將存取權限限制在特定律師及技術顧問範圍，但仍認為大部分對話與案件無關，《紐約時報》的要求可能侵犯一般使用者隱私。
到了2026年7月9日，雙方衝突再度升高。《紐約時報》、紐約《每日新聞》等媒體要求法院制裁OpenAI，指控OpenAI曾表示無法從訓練資料及ChatGPT輸出紀錄中搜尋新聞機構的著作權內容，但OpenAI員工後來作證稱，公司過去曾進行類似搜尋。
原告進一步指控OpenAI刪除數十億筆相關對話，或讓這些紀錄無法繼續搜尋，並要求法院命令OpenAI負擔律師費，同時對其作出不利的證據推定。
不過，這些目前仍屬原告提出的指控，並非法院已認定的事實。
OpenAI在8月14日提交反對意見，認為新聞機構將大型訴訟中的正常證據處理程序描述為蓄意阻撓，並扭曲相關事件。法院尚未就制裁動議作出裁決，《紐約時報》等原告須在9月10日前提交回覆。
另一方面，法院8月6日也撤銷新聞機構基於「終端使用者直接侵權」提出的部分幫助侵權主張，並拒絕《紐約時報》在訴訟後期針對微軟新增的幫助侵權理論；商標淡化訴求也遭撤銷。
不過，未經授權訓練模型、模型輸出是否構成新聞內容複製，以及相關行為是否屬於合理使用，仍是整起案件的核心爭議。
截至2026年8月底，法院仍未作出實體判決，任何一方都尚未贏得這場訴訟。

AI不一定消滅記者　但可能先改變新聞工作的樣貌

比著作權歸屬更早發生的變化，是AI已經進入新聞編輯部，逐步重新分配記者與機器的工作。
早在2014年，《美聯社》就開始利用自動化系統撰寫美國上市公司季度財報快訊。導入自動化工具前，《美聯社》記者每季約能完成300篇財報新聞；系統上線後，每季自動生成的稿件超過3000篇，數量增加10倍。
當時《美聯社》的說法並不是以機器取代記者，而是讓記者不必再花時間重複輸入營收、獲利及年增率等資訊，轉而投入財報電話會議、企業異常變化、產業趨勢及消息來源建立。
也就是說，機器接手的是格式化生產，而記者負責解讀數字背後的意義。
進入生成式AI時代後，機器處理的工作進一步擴大。除了結構化資料，AI如今也可以閱讀會議紀錄、整理採訪筆記、摘要文件，甚至產出新聞初稿。
美國俄亥俄州《克利夫蘭老實人報》已設立「AI改寫台」。記者提交採訪筆記、會議資料或錄音後，由AI生成短篇新聞初稿，再交由編輯審核。
支持這種做法的人認為，AI可以讓記者減少機械式寫作，把更多時間投入找線索、採訪及建立消息來源，也有助地方媒體在經營壓力下維持工作機會。
但另一種風險也隨之出現。若AI可以直接根據採訪筆記生成稿件，媒體對初階記者與文字編輯的需求可能下降。過去，年輕記者往往透過會議新聞、財報快訊及短消息累積基本功，這條進入新聞業的職涯路徑也可能因此受到影響。
因此，AI未必會一次性消滅「記者」這個職業，卻可能讓同樣規模的內容生產只需要更少的人力。
根據牛津大學路透新聞研究所《2025年新聞、媒體與科技趨勢及預測》報告，調查51個國家及地區、共326名媒體管理者後發現，87%的受訪者認為生成式AI正在「完全或一定程度上」改變編輯部，60%則將後台自動化視為非常重要的發展方向。
媒體準備探索的AI應用已涵蓋內容生產各個環節，包括將文字報導轉成音訊、在文章前加入AI摘要、翻譯新聞，以及提供AI聊天與搜尋服務。
換言之，AI改變的不只是「誰來寫稿」，而是從資料蒐集、錄音整理、翻譯、寫作、編輯，到標題、音訊、搜尋及內容分發的完整流程。

受眾仍更信任「有人負責」的新聞

不過，讀者並沒有準備把新聞完全交給機器。牛津大學路透新聞研究所研究員Felix Simon、哥本哈根大學教授Rasmus Kleis Nielsen及研究主任Richard Fletcher 2025年的一項六國調查顯示，僅12%的受訪者能接受完全由AI製作的新聞。
當新聞由記者主導、AI僅提供輔助時，可接受比例提高至43%；完全由人類製作的新聞，接受度則達62%。
受眾最能接受AI執行的工作包括拼字檢查、文法修改與翻譯；最難接受的則是AI記者、AI主持人，以及完全由機器獨立製作新聞。
這顯示大眾並非完全排斥AI，而是不願放棄新聞背後那個可以被追問、被查證，也必須承擔責任的人。
這也成為蘇茲伯格堅持《紐約時報》可以使用AI、卻不能把最終責任交給AI的原因。
分析指出，《紐約時報》所擔心的並非AI本身，而是新聞機構仍需承擔記者薪資、海外採訪、調查報導及法律風險等成本，AI公司卻可以憑藉技術與使用者入口，把這些新聞轉化為自己的答案，同時取得內容分發與主要利潤。
如果這種模式最終成形，記者這個職業或許不會立即消失，但願意持續投入資源進行原創報導的新聞機構可能逐漸減少。
屆時，世界看似擁有更多、更快的資訊，AI也能更迅速回答問題；但真正願意走進現場、挖掘機器尚不知道的事實的人，卻可能變得越來越少。

items.title: 標普500指數衝高背後 漲幅主要僅由微軟與輝達撐起
items.title_en: S&P 500 Index Surge Driven Mainly by Microsoft and Nvidia
paras: 美股在財報季後持續攀升並屢創新高，表面上呈現牛市態勢，然而，這波漲勢背後卻隱藏著極度不均衡的結構性問題。
專欄作家Rich Duprey撰文指出，自第二季財報季於7月13日開跑以來，標準普爾500指數的市值雖增長1.75兆美元，但有高達近八成(79%)的漲幅僅來自科技類股。其中，科技行業內部的增長幾乎全由微軟(MSFT-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)兩大龍頭撐起。
根據 Bespoke Investment Group 統計，微軟與輝達自7月13日以來，市值合計暴增了1.42兆美元。相較之下，科技行業中其餘的71檔個股，市值合計卻縮水了223億美元。Duprey表示，這根本不是市場健康的廣度，而是兩家公司承載了極其沉重的份量。換句話說，如果扣除這兩大龍頭，整個科技行業的表現實際上是衰退狀態。
在指數屢創新高的糖衣下，許多主要產業其實正承受著數千億美元的市值損失。數據顯示，自7月13日以來，各產業市值消長呈現兩極化：科技行業增加1.392兆美元、醫療保健增加3,452億美元、金融增加1,927億美元、能源增加1,747億美元；然而，通訊服務行業則大跌約3,000億美元，公用事業下跌885億美元，工業行業也下滑了673億美元。
Duprey分析，標普500指數之所以能在多個重要行業損失慘重的情況下繼續走高，完全是因為其「市值加權」的數學機制特性，使得市值最大的公司對指數走勢擁有決定性的影響力。微軟與輝達如今不僅是參與市場，更是實質上主導了整個大盤的去向。
Duprey警告，這種高度集中的現象給投資人帶來了「虛假的安全感」。只看大盤指數的投資人，可能會誤以為市場正全面上漲、企業基本面持續改善且市場信心普遍強勁，但事實上面臨著極大的風險。
購買標普500 ETF原本是為了在500家公司與11個產業中實現分散風險，雖然結構上依然存在多樣性，但整個投資組合的績效現在卻高度取決於少數幾檔超大型股的表現。一旦微軟或輝達在未來未能達到市場的完美預期，其龐大的市值加權權重將會拖累整個指數，即使數百家較小的企業表現優異也無濟於事。
Duprey強調，市場過度依賴這兩家公司維持「完美無瑕」的表現，一旦預期出現落差，容錯空間將微乎其微。
paras_en: U.S. equities have continued to climb and repeatedly hit new highs after earnings season, appearing bullish on the surface, yet this rally hides a severely imbalanced structural issue.

Columnist Rich Duprey notes that since the second‑quarter earnings season began on July 13, the S&P 500’s market cap has risen by $1.75 trillion, but almost four‑fifths (79%) of that gain came from technology stocks, with the growth inside tech almost entirely supported by the two giants Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Nvidia (NVDA‑US).

According to Bespoke Investment Group, Microsoft and Nvidia together have added $1.42 trillion in market value since July 13. By contrast, the other 71 tech stocks have collectively lost $22.3 billion. Duprey says this is not a healthy breadth of market performance; the two firms are shouldering an enormous weight, meaning that without them the tech sector is actually in decline.

Behind the index’s new‑high veneer, many core sectors are enduring hundreds of billions of dollars in market‑value losses. Data show that since July 13, sectoral market‑cap changes have been polarized: tech up $1.392 trillion, health care up $345.2 billion, financials up $192.7 billion, energy up $174.7 billion; meanwhile communications services fell about $300 billion, utilities down $88.5 billion, and industrials down $67.3 billion.

Duprey explains that the S&P 500 can keep rising despite heavy losses in several key industries because its market‑cap weighting gives the largest companies decisive influence over index movement. Microsoft and Nvidia now not only participate in the market but effectively steer the overall direction of the broad market.

Duprey warns that this high concentration gives investors a “false sense of security.” Those who look only at the broad index may mistakenly think the market is broadly rising, fundamentals are improving and confidence is strong, while in reality the situation carries substantial risk.

Buying an S&P 500 ETF was meant to achieve diversification across 500 companies and 11 sectors. Although the structure still contains variety, the portfolio’s performance now hinges heavily on a handful of mega‑caps. If Microsoft or Nvidia fail to meet market expectations in the future, their massive weighting will drag the whole index down, even if hundreds of smaller firms perform well.

Duprey stresses that the market’s over‑reliance on these two firms to maintain a “flawless” performance leaves virtually no margin for error; any disappointment in expectations could quickly erode confidence.

items.title: Michael Saylor高喊「We're Back！」微策略又準備加碼比特幣了？
items.title_en: Michael Saylor shouts “We’re Back!” Is MicroStrategy preparing to add more Bitcoin?
paras: 微策略(Strategy)(MSTR-US)執行董事長 Michael Saylor 周日(30日) 在 X 平台發表「We're Back」的三字推文，並配上公司購買比特幣的「橘點」累積圖表。市場紛紛猜測，微策略將重啟購買比特幣策略。
由於過去此類周末，發文往往預示著周一的購買公告，這家全球最大的企業比特幣持有者，過去兩個多月已中斷「買買買」步調，Saylor 也變得低調沉默。微策略上一次申報購買比特幣，已是 6 月 22 日的事。
過去兩個月微策略暫停購買，並打破長期以來「只買不賣」的原則，於 5 月至 8 月間多次出售比特幣以補強資產負債表、積累美元現金，並應對其後盾為比特幣的 STRC 優先股跌落 100 美元面值的危機。
然而，近期該公司的財務狀況已悄然改善：目前微策略持有約 66.9 億美元現金，與其約 67.1 億美元的債務相當，淨槓桿率降至 0.1%。此外，STRC 優先股已回升至 97 至 98 美元，大幅降低了公司因回購優先股而產生的資金消耗。
分析人士指出，微策略目前擁有接近四年的優先股股息覆蓋能力，這意味著短期內不需再售幣支付股息，新募集資金將更有可能直接用於加倉比特幣。目前微策略持有 840,447 枚比特幣。隨著比特幣在 8 月下旬回彈至 80,000 美元附近，
市場正密切關注微策略在周一(31日)是否會發布最新購買報告，這將驗證公司是否已正式從「補強期」邁入全新的「進攻期」。
paras_en: MicroStrategy (MSTR-US) Executive Chairman Michael Saylor posted a three‑word tweet “We’re Back” on X on Sunday the 30th, accompanied by the company’s “orange dot” cumulative Bitcoin purchase chart. The market is speculating that MicroStrategy will restart its Bitcoin buying strategy.

Because such weekend posts have historically signaled a Monday purchase announcement, the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin holder, which has paused its “buy‑buy‑buy” pace for over two months, saw Saylor go low‑key and silent. The last time MicroStrategy reported a Bitcoin purchase was on June 22.

In the past two months MicroStrategy halted buying and broke its long‑standing “buy‑only, no‑sell” rule, selling Bitcoin several times between May and August to shore up its balance sheet, accumulate US‑dollar cash, and address a crisis where its STRC preferred shares, backed by Bitcoin, fell to a $100 par value.

However, the company’s financial condition has quietly improved recently: MicroStrategy now holds about $6.69 billion in cash, roughly equal to its $6.71 billion debt, bringing its net leverage down to 0.1%. In addition, the STRC preferred shares have risen to $97‑$98, greatly reducing the cash drain from repurchasing the preferred stock.

Analysts note that MicroStrategy now has nearly four years of preferred‑share dividend coverage, meaning it does not need to sell Bitcoin to pay dividends in the short term, and new capital raised is more likely to be used to increase its Bitcoin position. The company currently holds 840,447 Bitcoin. As Bitcoin rebounded to around $80,000 in late August,

The market is closely watching whether MicroStrategy will issue a new purchase report on Monday the 31st, which would confirm that the firm has moved from a “strengthening phase” into a new “offensive phase.”

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉吳田玉：AI才剛開始 未來想像空間是現在百倍、千倍甚至萬倍
items.title_en: Semiconductor CEO Wu Tianyu: AI Is Just Beginning—Future Potential Could Be Hundreds, Thousands, or Even Ten Thousands Times Greater
paras: 日月光投控(3711-TW)(ASX-US)營運長吳田玉今(31)日表示，AI發展其實才剛剛開始，目前AI主要仍建立在人類過去數千年累積的經驗與知識之上，若未來能進一步跨領域整合並無限放大，其想像空間可能是現在的「百倍、千倍甚至萬倍」。也因此，台灣整個半導體生態系正全力加速AI基礎建設，希望讓AI盡快進入下一個發展階段。
吳田玉指出，若要用最簡單的方式定義AI，就是將人類經驗與知識數位化、把知識累積量化，再將成功經驗模式化，最後加速整個創新的過程。人類文明過去大致歷經知識累積、成功經驗複製，以及創新進步三個階段，而AI正在大幅加快這三個過程。
不過，他也坦言，AI發展初期勢必帶來不少擠壓效應。以台灣而言，AI相關投資快速增加後，已開始出現土地、人才、資金及電力等資源競爭；放眼全球，各國也可能因產業與資源集中產生地緣政治影響，甚至認為自身發展空間遭到排擠。
吳田玉認為，目前AI之所以容易讓外界產生「取代人類」的疑慮，主要是因為現階段AI仍從既有人類經驗出發，包括有人作業走向無人工廠、有人設備轉向無人設備，部分工作也可能遭自動化取代，因此短期確實會產生明顯的排擠感。
但他強調，若把時間拉長，AI真正的用途並不是取代人類已經知道、已經會做的事情，而是去完成過去人類「沒有看到、沒有想過、不能做、不願意做或不會做」的事情，進而創造全新的價值。
吳田玉舉例，目前AI應用已跨足製藥、癌症研究、醫療、化學、物理及人文等不同領域，透過持續擴大知識基礎、萃取成功模式並跨領域整合，有機會做到人類過去數千年未曾完成的大規模知識融合。
他指出，一旦AI能進一步協助製藥業開發出過去無法實現的癌症突破性藥物，或創造其他原本不存在的技術與應用，才真正代表AI從目前主要依賴既有人類經驗的階段，進一步跨入創新階段。
吳田玉表示，「AI真的是剛剛開始」，目前第一階段使用的，本質上仍是人類過去約五千年累積下來的經驗值，但若未來AI可以跨領域、持續放大知識與創新能力，其發展空間將遠超現在，可能達到百倍、千倍甚至萬倍。
他指出，台灣所有半導體與電子產業生態系目前都在加速投入，希望盡快把AI基礎建設建構完整，協助AI往下一階段發展。台灣目前從IC設計、晶圓製造，到光罩、設備材料及電子製造，已形成完整產業生態系，在全球AI需求大幅增加、供應鏈吃緊之際，產業也必須思考如何提供正確的產能，並在艱難環境下共同完成AI基礎建設。
至於全球供應吃緊下，台灣供應鏈是否應漲價、加速擴產或採取其他策略。吳田玉認為，關鍵在於如何看待AI真正價值發生的時間點。如果相信AI長期對人類的貢獻遠高於短期效益，現階段最重要的就是加速投資、提升效率，讓AI盡快跨入後續的創新階段。
不過，他也強調，產業不能忽略AI短期造成的衝擊，包括台灣內部在人力、資金、土地與電力等資源上的競爭，以及其他國家對產業集中可能產生的不安，因此台灣與全球其他國家的串聯與合作，是接下來一定要做的工作。
吳田玉表示，台灣半導體產業也必須向社會大眾、媒體、投資人及全球夥伴說清楚，AI短期確實會帶來資源排擠，但更大的價值是在後續跨領域創新及成功模式的大規模複製。
他並指出，台灣半導體能走到今天，也要感謝全球客戶過去約40年來，持續將IP、經驗、發展方向、投資與信任放在台灣，因此未來台灣除了持續加速投資，也必須明確向全球展現自身承諾。
吳田玉最後表示，台灣產業鏈必須讓全世界知道，「我們知道我們在做什麼，我們知道我們承諾了什麼，我們知道我們要交給大家什麼」，在處理AI短期擠壓與衝突的同時，持續推動投資與創新，才能讓AI真正走向下一個階段。
paras_en: Chief Operating Officer Wu Tianyu of Sun Moon Light Holdings (3711‑TW) (ASX‑US) said on the 31st that AI development is only just beginning. Currently, AI is still built on the experience and knowledge accumulated by humans over thousands of years. If it can further integrate across disciplines and amplify infinitely, its imaginative space could be a hundred, a thousand, or even ten thousand times larger than today. Consequently, Taiwan’s entire semiconductor ecosystem is accelerating AI infrastructure to bring AI into the next stage as quickly as possible.

Wu Tianyu explained that the simplest definition of AI is digitizing human experience and knowledge, quantifying accumulated knowledge, modeling successful experiences, and finally accelerating the entire innovation process. Human civilization has roughly gone through three stages: knowledge accumulation, replication of successful experience, and innovation progress, and AI is dramatically speeding up these three processes.

However, he admitted that the early stages of AI development will inevitably bring many squeeze effects. In Taiwan, after rapid increases in AI-related investment, competition for land, talent, capital, and electricity has already begun. Globally, countries may also experience geopolitical impacts due to industry and resource concentration, even feeling that their development space is being excluded.

Wu Tianyu believes that the reason AI currently raises concerns about “replacing humans” is that it still starts from existing human experience. This includes moving from human-operated factories to unmanned factories, from human-operated equipment to unmanned equipment, and some jobs may be replaced by automation, leading to a noticeable short‑term displacement effect.

But he emphasized that over a longer time horizon, AI’s true purpose is not to replace what humans already know and can do, but to accomplish things that humans have not seen, thought, could do, are unwilling to do, or cannot do, thereby creating entirely new value.

Wu Tianyu gave examples: AI applications have already crossed into pharmaceuticals, cancer research, medicine, chemistry, physics, and humanities. By continuously expanding the knowledge base, extracting successful models, and integrating across disciplines, there is an opportunity to achieve large‑scale knowledge integration that humans have not accomplished in the past thousands of years.

He pointed out that once AI can further help the pharmaceutical industry develop breakthrough cancer drugs that were previously impossible, or create other technologies and applications that did not exist before, it will truly represent AI moving from its current stage of relying on existing human experience into the innovation stage.

Wu Tianyu said, “AI is really just beginning.” The first stage of use is essentially the experience accumulated over about five thousand years of human history. If AI can cross disciplines and continuously amplify knowledge and innovation capability, its development space will far exceed the present, potentially reaching hundreds, thousands, or even ten thousands of times greater.

He noted that Taiwan’s entire semiconductor and electronics ecosystem is accelerating investment, hoping to quickly build a complete AI infrastructure to help AI progress to the next stage. Taiwan currently has a complete industry ecosystem from IC design, wafer manufacturing, to photomasks, equipment materials, and electronic manufacturing. In the face of a sharp increase in global AI demand and tightening supply chains, the industry must consider how to provide the right capacity and complete AI infrastructure together in a difficult environment.

Regarding tightening global supply, whether Taiwan’s supply chain should raise prices, accelerate expansion, or adopt other strategies, Wu Tianyu believes the key lies in how to view the timing of AI’s real value creation. If one believes AI’s long‑term contribution to humanity far exceeds short‑term benefits, the most important thing at this stage is to accelerate investment and improve efficiency, so that AI can quickly enter the subsequent innovation stage.

However, he also stressed that the industry cannot ignore the short‑term impacts of AI, including competition for human resources, capital, land, and electricity within Taiwan, as well as the unease that other countries may feel due to industry concentration. Therefore, Taiwan’s collaboration with other countries worldwide is essential work for the future.

Wu Tianyu said that the Taiwanese semiconductor industry must also explain to the public, media, investors, and global partners that AI will indeed cause resource displacement in the short term, but the greater value lies in large‑scale replication of cross‑disciplinary innovation and successful models in the future.

He added that Taiwan’s semiconductor industry has reached its current position thanks to global customers’ continuous investment, trust, and direction over the past 40 years. Therefore, Taiwan must continue to accelerate investment and clearly demonstrate its commitment to the world.

Finally, Wu Tianyu said that the Taiwanese supply chain must let the world know, “We know what we are doing, we know what we have committed to, and we know what we will deliver.” While handling short‑term squeeze and conflict, continuous investment and innovation must be promoted so that AI can truly move into the next stage.

items.title: 蘋果換帥進入AI決戰時代！特納斯接班庫克首要考驗：能否靠AI重拾競爭優勢
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 週二（9月1日）將正式迎來執行長換帥，特納斯（John Ternus）將接替庫克（Tim Cook），成為繼賈伯斯（Steve Jobs）與庫克之後，第三位掌舵這家全球市值最高科技公司的執行長。
根據《彭博》最新分析，特納斯上任後面臨的核心課題相當明確：如何帶領這家以硬體產品見長的消費電子巨頭，在人工智慧（AI）時代重新建立競爭優勢。
特納斯上任後隨即面臨關鍵考驗，包括9月的iPhone新品發表，以及蘋果新版Siri AI的全面部署。新版Siri經過重新打造，被視為ChatGPT的直接競爭者，早期評價相對正面，但能否扭轉Siri長期被認為「不好用」的市場印象，仍有待觀察。
與此同時，庫克並未完全退出蘋果核心決策圈。他將以執行董事長身分留任，繼續負責蘋果與美國總統川普政府及中國政府的關係，並在特納斯需要時提供協助。
分析指出，對蘋果股東而言，這場交棒的關鍵並不只是執行長人事更替，而是特納斯能否讓蘋果在AI浪潮下重新找到成長方向。
特納斯主導的產品藍圖包括首款可摺疊iPhone、AI智慧眼鏡及家用顯示設備；與此同時，蘋果AI發展落後、人才流失加劇，以及服務業務成長放緩，都成為新任執行長必須處理的壓力。

AI發展落後成蘋果面臨最迫切挑戰

生成式AI在2022年底因ChatGPT崛起後迅速席捲科技產業，雖然蘋果隨即增加相關投資，包括自行開發大型語言模型、以高薪延攬AI人才及尋找收購標的，但首版Apple Intelligence表現不如預期，重要AI收購也未能完成。
在此之後，庫克撤換蘋果AI部門主管，並重新整頓Siri團隊。蘋果更在去年改變原本自行開發模型的方向，轉而付費採用Google(GOOGL-US) Gemini技術，作為新版Siri的底層基礎。
這項決策也造成蘋果內部大型語言模型團隊的不滿，包括團隊主管在內的多名核心成員陸續離職，並轉往提供更高薪酬的競爭對手。
新版Siri AI預計9月全面推出，蘋果長期則可能透過向用戶或開發者收費，或整合第三方應用程式來尋找商業化模式。
不過，這些模式能否成立，前提仍是Siri必須先獲得用戶信任。

硬體新品成為AI時代的押注

特納斯在蘋果任職25年，最初從Mac工程師做起，之後逐步參與iPad、AirPods、iPhone等產品，最終掌管整個硬體工程體系，是蘋果內部最具代表性的硬體專家之一。
如今由他主導的產品藍圖相當積極。蘋果今年秋季將推出首款可摺疊iPhone，以及一款能辨識說話者並根據個人需求推送內容的智慧顯示設備。後續產品還包括搭載攝影機的AirPods、智慧眼鏡、家用安防系統、配備機械臂的家用顯示器，以及可穿戴式攝影機吊墜。
不過，特納斯對庫克力推的Vision Pro混合實境頭戴裝置態度較為冷淡。知情人士透露，他認為Vision Pro重量過重且價格高昂，難以成為主流產品。
近期蘋果已縮減Vision Pro相關團隊人力，涉及裝置安全、音訊工程、Siri整合、測試及作業系統等領域。
相較之下，特納斯支持蘋果代號N50的智慧眼鏡計畫，該產品預計明年推出。不過，如果頭戴式裝置始終無法獲得市場認可，特納斯也可能縮減這項產品線，屆時可能影響代號N224、最早預計於2028年底推出的新一代Vision Pro。
除了推出AI硬體產品，特納斯也試圖將AI導入蘋果自身的產品開發流程。他在擔任硬體主管期間推出一套AI平台，目標是加快產品開發並提高硬體測試效率。

核心人才流失　蘋果面臨內部挑戰

除了產品與AI策略，人才流失也是特納斯接任後的重要問題。
蘋果過去一直是頂尖硬體人才的重要去處，但目前已有數百名前蘋果員工加入OpenAI硬體部門。蘋果甚至已就此提起訴訟，指控OpenAI竊取商業機密，而特納斯本人也是批准這起訴訟的決策者之一。
為了留住關鍵人才，特納斯曾向iPhone設計團隊多名成員發放數十萬美元額外獎金，也親自參與部分人才挽留工作。
其中一名來自新加坡的工程師曾受到蘋果挽留。特納斯要求iPhone設計主管Richard Dinh與該員工會面，並提出升職與加薪條件，但這名工程師最終仍選擇加入OpenAI。
知情人士透露，蘋果目前約半數高階主管可能在未來幾年離開公司。其中一項關鍵潛在風險是首席硬體長Johny Srouji。這名61歲高階主管去年曾向庫克表達離職意願，在獲得擴大職責並協助執行長交接後暫時留任，但知情人士指出，他仍可能在未來一、兩年內離開。
此外，蘋果行銷、服務及零售部門主管都已在公司任職約40年，未來幾年也可能陸續退休。

庫克退居幕後但不完全離場　特納斯能否順利接班成關鍵

庫克掌舵蘋果15年，任內公司營收從約1000億美元成長至4160億美元，市值則增加約15倍。他8月23日曾在蘋果園區出席同事為他舉辦的告別晚宴，但這並不代表他將完全離開蘋果。
庫克已明確告知特納斯，他將繼續處理蘋果與川普政府及中國政府的關係，也願意承擔接班人認為有必要的其他工作。他也向員工表示，蘋果仍將是自己的「第一優先級」。
據《彭博》報導，蘋果內部將特納斯與庫克的搭檔模式，與亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 創辦人貝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）及執行長Andy Jassy的交接模式相提並論，認為兩者最為接近。
但企業接班也存在另一種可能。迪士尼(DIS-US) 前執行長Bob Iger曾以顧問身分留任，之後卻與接班人Bob Chapek發生衝突，最終重新回任執行長。對蘋果而言，如何處理這場逐步完成的權力交接，將成為特納斯能否建立自己領導地位的重要考驗。
目前特納斯已開始主導蘋果與華爾街分析師的溝通，並在與庫克共同參與的2027年規劃會議中逐漸取得主導權。
9月9日的iPhone發表會，將是特納斯首次以蘋果執行長身分公開亮相；與此同時，庫克也將首次在15年來不再以主角身分站上這場蘋果年度重要舞台。

items.title: 日產、本田共建次世代車輛軟體架構2029年導入量產車
items.title_en: Nissan and Honda to Build Next-Generation Vehicle Software Architecture, Launch in Production Cars in 2029
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本車廠在軟體定義汽車競賽加速結盟。日產汽車與本田汽車簽署共同開發協議，將合作打造次世代車輛的核心系統與軟體，並計畫自2029年4月起的會計年度開始導入旗下車款。兩家公司先前的合併談判雖告破局，技術合作仍持續深化，顯示日本車廠正以共同平台回應全球電動化與智慧車競爭。
合作重點是標準化車輛電子架構與關鍵軟體，整合雙方工程人才與研發資源，以降低重複投資並擴大規模經濟。隨車輛價值逐步由機械性能轉向軟體、資料與持續更新能力，共用架構不僅有助縮短開發週期，也可能提高零組件、晶片及軟體模組的採購規模，重新塑造日本汽車供應鏈。
日產與本田兩年多前已開始研究電動車、核心零組件與軟體合作，但去年底提出的合併案在不到兩個月內破裂，主因是本田希望將日產納為子公司。如今雙方改採較具彈性的技術聯盟，反映車廠即使維持獨立品牌，也難以單獨承擔智慧車平台、電動化及軟體人才的龐大資本支出。

paras_en: On August 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Japanese automakers are accelerating alliances in the software-defined vehicle race. Nissan Motor and Honda Motor have signed a joint development agreement to create the core systems and software for next‑generation vehicles, with plans to introduce the technology into their model lines starting the fiscal year beginning April 2029. Although earlier merger talks between the two companies fell apart, technical cooperation continues to deepen, showing that Japanese carmakers are responding to global electrification and smart‑vehicle competition with a shared platform.

The partnership focuses on standardising vehicle electronic architecture and key software, integrating engineering talent and R&D resources from both sides to cut duplicate investment and achieve economies of scale. As vehicle value shifts from mechanical performance toward software, data and continuous update capability, a common architecture not only shortens development cycles but could also increase procurement volumes for components, chips and software modules, reshaping Japan’s automotive supply chain.

Nissan and Honda began exploring EVs, core components and software collaboration more than two years ago, but the merger proposal put forward at the end of last year collapsed in less than two months, mainly because Honda wanted to make Nissan a subsidiary. The two now adopt a more flexible technology alliance, reflecting that even while maintaining independent brands, automakers find it difficult to shoulder the massive capital outlays for smart‑vehicle platforms, electrification and software talent on their own.

items.title: 法國量子計算公司Pasqal掛牌首日股價翻倍 前景引發市場關注
items.title_en: French Quantum Computing Company Pasqal Doubles Stock Price on First Trading Day, Drawing Market Attention
paras: 法國中性原子量子計算公司 Pasqal 上周五(28日) 正式與特殊目的收購公司(SPAC)Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II 完成合併，於美國那斯達克交易所掛牌上市，代碼PSQL。上市首日，該公司股價自參考價 9.79 美元一路攀升，最終收於 19.11 美元，全天漲幅達 95%，為公司帶來約 3.6 億美元的現金，合併時的投前估值約為 20 億美元。
根據財務數據，Pasqal 在 2025 年的營收為 1,650 萬歐元(約 1,915 萬美元)，相較於 2024 年的 350 萬歐元有顯著成長。若以 20 億美元的估值計算，其股價營收比(P/S 比)約為 100 倍。
此估值倍數在量子計算產業中已顯得相對克制，例如同業 Quantinuum 上市時的股價營收比高達 500 倍。然而，高估值倍數並非反映現有的獲利，而是市場對其未來收入的期權定價。
此外，由於本次合併的股份贖回率超過 90%，導致市場自由流通股數有限，首日大漲更偏向流動性事件，而非基本面的重估。
在技術路線上，Pasqal 專注於「中性原子」技術，利用雷射囚禁並操控單個原子作為量子位元。公司共同創辦人之一為 2022 年諾貝爾物理學獎得主阿斯佩(Alain Aspect)。Pasqal 執行長博哈里(Wasiq Bokhari)表示，該技術使用原子而非晶片，能節省製造半導體的時間與成本，且系統可在常溫下運行並整合至標準數據中心，耗電量僅相當於吹風機。
博哈里強調：「今天不是終點，而是加速點。Pasqal 旨在將中性原子量子計算自基礎科學推向工業級部署。」
然而，公司的資本結構面臨特殊的法規約束。根據申報文件，非歐盟投資人若欲取得該公司重大股權，須獲得法國經濟部的授權。
這項被視為法國政府的「終止開關」條款雖保障了國家安全，但也為資本形成帶來摩擦，壓縮了自由流通股，可能進一步放大股價的波動性。面對中性原子技術的全球競爭，包含美國離子阱技術及中國中科酷原等同業的急起直追，市場將持續檢視 Pasqal 能否將現有的訂單轉化為持續性營收。
paras_en: French neutral‑atom quantum computing company Pasqal completed its merger with special‑purpose acquisition company Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II last Friday (the 28th) and listed on the Nasdaq under the ticker PSQL. On its debut, the share price rose from the reference price of $9.79 to close at $19.11, a 95% gain for the day, raising about $360 million in cash and implying a pre‑merger valuation of roughly $2 billion.

According to financial data, Pasqal’s revenue for 2025 is projected at €16.5 million (about $19.15 million), a significant increase from €3.5 million in 2024. Using the $2 billion valuation, the price‑to‑sales (P/S) multiple is about 100×.

This multiple is relatively restrained within the quantum‑computing sector; for example, peer Quantinuum debuted with a P/S ratio as high as 500×. However, the high multiple reflects market pricing of future revenue options rather than current profitability.

Moreover, the merger’s share‑redemption rate exceeded 90%, limiting the number of freely tradable shares. The sharp first‑day rise therefore reflects a liquidity event more than a fundamental re‑rating.

Technically, Pasqal focuses on neutral‑atom technology, using lasers to trap and manipulate individual atoms as qubits. One co‑founder is 2022 Nobel laureate in physics Alain Aspect. CEO Wasiq Bokhari said the atom‑based approach saves semiconductor manufacturing time and cost, runs at room temperature, can be integrated into standard data centers, and consumes power comparable to a hair‑dryer.
Bokhari emphasized: “Today is not the finish line, but an acceleration point. Pasqal aims to move neutral‑atom quantum computing from basic science to industrial‑scale deployment.”

However, the company’s capital structure faces specific regulatory constraints. According to filing documents, non‑EU investors must obtain authorization from the French Ministry of Economy to acquire a significant stake in the firm.

This “kill‑switch” clause, viewed as a French government safeguard for national security, also creates friction in capital formation, compresses the free‑float and could amplify price volatility. Facing global competition in neutral‑atom technology—from U.S. ion‑trap players to China’s Zhongke Cool‑Atom—markets will keep watching whether Pasqal can turn existing orders into sustainable revenue.

items.title: 比亞迪上半年淨利衰退20.5%，香港股價跌逾5%、海外出口逆勢增67.8%
items.title_en: BYD's H1 Net Profit Falls 20.5%, Hong Kong Shares Slip Over 5% as Overseas Exports Surge 67.8%
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國電動車龍頭比亞迪BYD(1211-HK)公布2026年上半年財報，在中國車市需求疲弱、價格競爭激烈，加上原物料與半導體成本上升影響下，營收與獲利同步下滑，財報公布後香港股價31日下跌超過5%。
比亞迪2026年上半年營收3,448億元人民幣，年減率7.1%；歸屬股東淨利約18億美元，年減率20.5%，獲利降幅明顯高於營收，反映產業競爭與成本上升持續壓縮利潤空間。
不過，第2季營運已有改善跡象。單季營收292億美元，年減率3%，但淨利升至12.2億美元，年增率30%，顯示在營收尚未恢復成長的情況下，單季獲利已率先回升。
比亞迪表示，2026年上半年中國汽車市場內需相對疲弱，激烈的市場競爭，加上大宗商品、原物料及半導體成本上升，均對車廠利潤率形成壓力。
相較中國市場承壓，海外成為比亞迪主要成長動能。2026年1月至6月出口量達79.2萬輛，年增率高達67.8%，顯示公司正透過海外市場快速擴張，降低中國市場價格競爭對銷售成長的影響。
中國高階品牌則維持成長。旗下方程豹、騰勢與仰望品牌上半年合計銷量年增率61%，占集團乘用車銷量12.8%。在中國電動車市場競爭從銷量進一步轉向價格與獲利能力之際，比亞迪能否透過海外市場擴張與高階品牌提高產品組合，將成為後續利潤率能否持續改善的重要觀察指標。

Compared with the pressured Chinese market, overseas sales became BYD’s main growth driver. Export volume from January to June 2026 reached 792,000 units, a year‑on‑year increase of 67.8%, indicating the company is rapidly expanding abroad to offset the impact of price competition at home on sales growth.

China’s premium brands continued to grow. Sales of the Fangcheng, Tengshi and Yangwang brands combined rose 61% year over year in the first half, accounting for 12.8% of the group’s passenger‑car sales. As competition in the Chinese EV market shifts from volume to price and profitability, BYD’s ability to boost margins through overseas expansion and premium‑brand mix will be a key gauge of future profit‑margin improvement.

paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI算力競爭持續向電力與資料中心基礎建設延伸。據《華爾街日報》引述SB Energy上市文件草案報導，OpenAI取得這家電力基礎設施公司的認股權證，估計價值約55億美元，使雙方合作關係不只停留在資料中心租賃，也進一步延伸至股權投資。

值得注意的是，SB Energy近期已成為AI產業大型資本的重要布局標的。輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)本月稍早向SB Energy投資15億美元，並同意提供最高1,050億美元擔保，協助OpenAI租用SB Energy正在美國俄亥俄州開發的資料中心。
根據報導，軟銀與OpenAI也規畫成為SB Energy旗下3座資料中心的承租戶。這意味SB Energy同時串聯AI模型業者、GPU供應商與大型資本，角色從單純的能源開發商逐漸向AI資料中心與電力基礎設施平台延伸。

items.title: Bugatti執行長看車市兩極化：平價車走向電動化，頂級超跑仍由燃油引擎主導
items.title_en: Bugatti CEO Sees Car Market Polarization: Affordable Cars Turning Electric, Top Supercars Still Driven by Combustion Engines
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Bugatti執行長Mate Rimac認為，未來汽車市場將走向明顯兩極化。大眾市場方面，隨中國車廠持續擴大競爭力，價格更親民的電動車可望逐步成為主流；但在高階跑車與豪華車市場，燃油引擎仍將保有重要地位。
Rimac指出，頂級豪華車買家追求的並不只是科技功能，而是工藝、機械感受與情緒價值。這類消費邏輯更接近瑞士高級機械錶，即使數位產品在功能與效率上更先進，傳統機械產品仍能憑藉品牌、手工製作與獨特體驗維持高價值。
因此，他認為電動化不會完全取代燃油車，而是會依市場定位形成不同發展路徑。對一般消費者而言，價格、使用成本與效率更重要，電動車優勢會逐漸擴大；但對超高資產族群而言，稀有性、客製化與駕駛體驗的重要性更高，燃油超跑仍有穩定需求。
這也反映Bugatti的經營方向。Rimac希望在維持品牌稀缺性與高階定位的前提下，提高產量與獲利能力，而非單純追求規模。公司目前已具備可觀獲利，未來重點將放在如何擴大高毛利客製化產品，同時避免稀釋品牌價值。

paras_en: August 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac believes the future automotive market will become distinctly polarized. In the mass‑market segment, as Chinese automakers continue to expand their competitiveness, more affordable electric vehicles are expected to gradually become mainstream; however, in the high‑end sports‑car and luxury‑car segment, combustion engines will still hold an important position.

Rimac points out that buyers of top‑tier luxury cars seek more than just technological features—they value craftsmanship, mechanical feel, and emotional value. This consumer logic is closer to that of Swiss high‑end mechanical watches; even though digital products are more advanced in function and efficiency, traditional mechanical products can still maintain high value through brand heritage, hand‑craftsmanship, and unique experience.

Therefore, he believes electrification will not completely replace combustion cars but will follow different development paths according to market positioning. For ordinary consumers, price, operating cost and efficiency matter more, so the advantages of electric vehicles will gradually expand; for ultra‑wealthy individuals, rarity, customization and driving experience are paramount, keeping demand for fuel‑powered supercars stable.

This also reflects Bugatti’s business strategy. Rimac wants to increase production and profitability while preserving the brand’s scarcity and premium positioning, rather than simply pursuing scale. The company already enjoys solid profits, and future focus will be on expanding high‑margin customized products without diluting brand value.

items.title: 福特Lincoln轉向美國生產，雪佛蘭暫停中國新車銷售，外資車廠加速重整中國布局
items.title_en: Ford's Lincoln Shifts to U.S. Production, Chevrolet Pauses New Car Sales in China, Foreign Automakers Accelerate Restructuring of China Footprint
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球傳統車廠正重新調整中國與美國市場布局。福特Ford(F-US)計畫自2030年起提高豪華品牌Lincoln在美國的生產比重，逐步降低自中國進口，以因應高關稅成本；另一方面，雪佛蘭Chevrolet則將暫停在中國推出新車，轉而把重心放在出口市場，反映外資品牌在中國新能源車競爭加劇下承受更大壓力。
福特目前部分Lincoln車款仍由中國出口至美國，其中Lincoln Nautilus面臨高達52.5%的進口關稅。執行長Jim Farley表示，提高美國本土生產不僅可降低關稅影響，也符合公司強化美國製造的方向，預計可創造數千個工作機會並擴大當地汽車產業基礎。
相較之下，雪佛蘭在中國面臨的是需求與產品競爭力問題。隨本土品牌快速轉向純電動車與插電式混合動力車，傳統外資品牌在電動化速度、產品更新及價格競爭上逐漸落後，導致銷量持續下滑。雪佛蘭因此暫停中國市場的新車銷售布局，並把更多資源轉向出口。

Ford (F‑US) plans to increase the share of its luxury brand Lincoln produced in the United States starting in 2030, gradually reducing imports from China to offset high tariff costs; meanwhile Chevrolet will suspend the launch of new models in China and shift its focus to export markets, reflecting the growing pressure on foreign brands as competition intensifies in China’s new‑energy vehicle sector.

Ford currently ships some Lincoln models from China to the United States, with the Lincoln Nautilus facing import duties as high as 52.5%. In contrast, Chevrolet’s challenges in China stem from demand and product competitiveness. As domestic brands rapidly pivot to pure‑electric and plug‑in hybrid vehicles, traditional foreign brands are falling behind in electrification speed, product updates, and price competition, leading to a continual decline in sales. Consequently, Chevrolet is pausing its new‑car sales rollout in the Chinese market and reallocating more resources toward exports.

items.title_en: Toyota Raises Full-Year Profit Forecast, Honda’s Operating Profit Doubles
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本兩大車廠豐田Toyota(7203-JP)與本田Honda(7267-JP)最新財報呈現不同走勢。豐田將全年利潤預測上調13%至3.25兆日圓，主要受惠日圓走弱，以及美國與印度市場需求強勁；不過，第1季營業利益仍年減9%，反映中國銷售下滑與地緣政治相關成本上升帶來壓力。
相較之下，本田營運表現明顯改善，營業利益達5,307億日圓，年增率接近100%，並創下新高，主要受機車事業支撐，加上汽車銷售回溫，尤其北美市場表現改善。
兩家公司目前都面臨匯率波動與原物料成本上升影響，但應對策略有所不同。豐田持續受惠於全球市場分散布局，美國與印度需求抵銷部分中國市場疲弱；本田則更加重視油電混合動力車，以因應純電動車需求成長不如預期，以及電動車生產與投資帶來的壓力。
中國市場競爭加劇，加上純電動車價格戰與需求變化，使傳統車廠必須在燃油車、油電混合與純電動車之間重新配置資源。豐田與本田雖都面臨中國市場壓力，但目前獲利改善主要仍來自北美、印度及機車等相對強勢業務。

Toyota raised its full‑year profit forecast by 13% to 3.25 trillion yen, largely thanks to a weaker yen and strong demand in the United States and India; however, operating profit in the first quarter still fell 9% year‑on‑year, reflecting a decline in Chinese sales and pressure from geopolitically related cost increases.

Toyota continues to benefit from a globally diversified market layout, with U.S. and Indian demand offsetting some weakness in China; Honda places greater emphasis on hybrid vehicles to cope with slower-than‑expected growth in pure electric vehicle demand and the pressures of EV production and investment.

Competition in the Chinese market has intensified, and the price war and demand shifts in pure electric vehicles force traditional automakers to reallocate resources among fuel‑powered, hybrid, and pure electric models. Although both Toyota and Honda face pressure in China, their profit improvements mainly stem from stronger operations in North America, India, and the motorcycle segment.

items.title: 手機出貨恐重挫逾一成，為何面板只減2.5%？維修翻新需求成關鍵
items.title_en: Mobile Shipments May Decline Over 10%, Why Panels Only Drop 2.5%? Repair and Refurbishment Demand Is Key
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 2026年全球智慧手機市場面臨近年罕見的衰退壓力，但手機面板卻展現截然不同的韌性。IDC預估全年智慧手機出貨量年減率達16.7%，Counterpoint Research預估年減14.3%；相較之下，TrendForce集邦諮詢最新預估全球智慧手機面板出貨約22.5億片，年減率僅2.5%，形成明顯落差。
為何手機整機需求大幅下滑，面板出貨卻只小幅衰退？關鍵在於兩者涵蓋的需求不同。智慧手機出貨主要反映新機市場，但手機面板除了供應新機，還涵蓋維修、售後替換及翻新手機等需求，因此面板出貨並不會與新機銷售呈現完全同步的變化。
尤其當記憶體與其他零組件價格上漲推高新機成本，品牌廠縮減生產規畫，消費者換機週期也隨之拉長。新機需求受到壓抑的同時，既有手機使用時間延長，進一步支撐維修、換屏與翻新市場需求，形成新機市場走弱、售後市場相對成長的此消彼長格局。
Omdia預估，2026年用於新智慧手機的面板需求將年減12%；但2026年第1季供應維修及翻新手機市場的面板出貨量卻達2.98億片，年增率20%，首度超過同期供應智慧手機製造商的2.89億片。這也成為整機出貨大幅衰退之際，手機面板總出貨仍能維持相對韌性的關鍵原因。
值得注意的是，翻新市場的需求也開始由LCD向OLED擴大。2026年第1季OLED占翻新智慧手機面板出貨比重由2025年同期的2%提高至7%，反映隨全球OLED手機保有量增加，更多OLED機種正逐步進入維修與二手機市場週期。

paras_en: On August 31, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – The global smartphone market faces a rare downturn this year, yet smartphone panels show a starkly different resilience. IDC forecasts a 16.7% year‑over‑year decline in total smartphone shipments, while Counterpoint Research estimates a 14.3% drop; in contrast, TrendForce’s latest estimate puts global smartphone panel shipments at about 2.25 billion units, with only a 2.5% year‑over‑year decline, creating a clear gap.

Why does overall smartphone demand fall sharply while panel shipments decline only modestly? The key lies in the different demand scopes. Smartphone shipments mainly reflect new‑device sales, whereas panels also serve repair, after‑sales replacement, and refurbishment needs, so panel shipments do not move in lockstep with new‑device sales.

Especially when memory and other component prices rise, pushing up new‑device costs, brands cut production plans and consumers extend their device‑replacement cycles. While new‑device demand is suppressed, existing phones last longer, further supporting repair, screen replacement, and refurbishment markets, creating a scenario where the new‑device market weakens while the after‑sales market grows.

Omdia projects that panel demand for new smartphones in 2026 will fall 12% year‑over‑year; however, in Q1 2026, panels supplied to repair and refurbishment markets reached 298 million units, a 20% year‑over‑year increase, surpassing the 289 million units supplied to smartphone manufacturers for the first time. This explains why, amid a sharp decline in overall device shipments, total panel shipments remain relatively resilient.

Notably, the refurbishment market is also shifting from LCD to OLED. In Q1 2026, OLED accounted for 7% of refurbished smartphone panel shipments, up from 2% in the same period in 2025, reflecting the growing global OLED smartphone base and the gradual entry of OLED models into repair and second‑hand cycles.

items.title: 日元貶破160防線 當局隨時突襲干預、緊盯兩個關鍵價位
items.title_en: Yen Breaks 160 Barrier, Authorities Ready to Intervene at Key Levels
paras: 日元兌美元貶破160防線，凸顯出日元極易受到進一步走貶的衝擊，也大幅提高日本當局再次進場干預、阻貶匯率的風險。
儘管確切干預門檻仍不明朗，但多名策略師周一(31日)警告，可能促使當局出手阻止日元急貶的價位不少，最近的觀察點從161開始，其次是162至163區間。不過，他們仍認為，干預行動頂多只能爭取時間，因為日元已回吐7月底展開史上最大規模干預以來逾半數漲幅。
日元最新一波跌勢，主要受到美元上周五全面走強帶動，市場預期美國利率將維持在更高水準，也進一步印證日元走勢很大程度並非日本所能掌控。
日本7月進場干預後，日元未能升破155，隨後再度承壓。當時美國與日本聯手買進日元，是雙方自1998年以來首度採取協調干預行動。
三井住友日興證券資深利率與外匯策略師丸山倫斗表示：「就關鍵價位而言，首先要觀察161，其次是162.9至163.3區間，這是當局上次進場干預的位置。」不過，他指出，政府在前一次干預時「相當重視出其不意」，意味當局隨時都可能採取行動。
周一東京時間上午11點50分，日元兌美元匯率報159.77，較上周五紐約收盤價約160.09升值約0.2%。
根據日本財務省數據顯示，日本在過去一個月內砸下創紀錄的964億美元來支撐日元，此前日元曾崩跌至40年來的低點。財務大臣片山皐月與美國財政部長貝森特皆已暗示，必要時願意再次採取行動。
日本官員多次表明，評估是否有必要干預的關鍵在於匯率變動的速度與失序程度，而非任何特定的匯價水準。
貝森特也曾表示，他期望日本央行總裁植田和男能在貨幣政策上「做出正確的事」，同時形容近期日元的波動「相當受到控制」。
交換市場定價顯示，日本銀行在9月18日政策會議前升息的機率達90%，市場更已完全反映最晚10月30日前升息的預期。
澳洲國民銀行策略師Rodrigo Catril表示：「我們認為，美元兌日元升破162後，干預風險才會明顯升高。當美元全面走強，加上聯準會釋出鷹派訊號時，日本很難出手干預。」
投機性部位也再度轉向不利日元。避險基金在干預後一度大幅削減看空部位，如今又開始建立日元空單。自2025年7月以來，避險基金整體上一直對日元抱持負面看法。
澳洲聯邦銀行策略師Carol Kong表示：「如果日元快速貶值，我不認為日本當局一定要等到日本銀行開會後才再度干預。不過，由於市場已高度反映9月升息的可能性，當局或許會傾向先觀察貨幣政策能否發揮部分支撐日元的效果。」
市場人士指出，只要日本實質利率仍處於深度負值，單靠干預恐怕難以扭轉日元走勢。
華僑銀行策略師Moh Siong Sim認為，鑑於市場預期的升息幅度有限，日本央行正陷入更大的兩難。看來勢必得祭出鼓勵資金回流等其他政策工具，才能扭轉日元疲弱的頹勢。
paras_en: The yen fell below the 160 barrier against the dollar, highlighting its vulnerability to further depreciation and significantly raising the risk of Japanese authorities stepping in to curb the decline.

Although the exact intervention threshold remains unclear, several strategists warned on Monday (31st) that intervention could be triggered at several levels, starting at 161 and then the 162‑163 range. They still believe intervention would only buy time, as the yen has already reversed more than half of the gains since the largest intervention in history at the end of July.

The latest yen selloff was mainly driven by a comprehensive strengthening of the dollar last Friday, with markets expecting U.S. rates to remain higher, further confirming that the yen’s trajectory is largely beyond Japan’s control.

After Japan intervened in July, the yen failed to break above 155 and was subsequently pressured again. At that time, the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen, marking the first coordinated intervention since 1998.

Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities senior interest‑rate and FX strategist Tomoaki Maruyama said, "The key levels to watch are first 161, then the 162.9‑163.3 range, where the authorities last intervened." He added that the government placed great emphasis on surprise in the previous intervention, implying that action could be taken at any time.
At 11:50 a.m. Tokyo time on Monday, the yen was quoted at 159.77 against the dollar, about 0.2% stronger than the New York close on Friday at 160.09.

According to data from Japan’s Ministry of Finance, Japan spent a record 96.4 billion dollars in the past month to support the yen, after it had fallen to a 40‑year low. Finance Minister Hitoshi Katayama and U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen have both signaled willingness to act again if necessary.
Japanese officials have repeatedly stated that the key to deciding whether to intervene lies in the speed and disorder of the exchange‑rate movement, not any specific rate level.
Yellen also said she expects Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda to "do the right thing" in monetary policy, describing the recent yen volatility as "quite controlled."
Market pricing in the foreign‑exchange market shows a 90% probability of a rate hike at the BoJ policy meeting on September 18, with the market fully pricing in a hike by October 30 at the latest.

Australia’s National Australia Bank strategist Rodrigo Catril said, "We believe the risk of intervention rises significantly once the dollar rises above 162 against the yen. With the dollar strengthening and the Fed issuing hawkish signals, Japan would find it difficult to intervene."

Speculative positions have again turned against the yen. Hedge funds had previously cut short positions after intervention, but are now re‑building yen shorts. Since July 2025, hedge funds have generally maintained a negative view of the yen.

Australia’s Commonwealth Bank strategist Carol Kong said, "If the yen depreciates rapidly, I don’t think Japan will wait until the BoJ meeting to intervene again. However, since the market already reflects the likelihood of a September hike, authorities may prefer to observe whether monetary policy can provide some support for the yen."
Market participants note that as long as Japan’s real rates remain deeply negative, intervention alone is unlikely to reverse the yen’s trend.

China‑based Bank of China strategist Moh Siong Sim believes that given the limited expected rate hikes, the BoJ is in a deeper dilemma. It appears that other policy tools, such as encouraging capital inflows, will be needed to reverse the yen’s weak trajectory.

items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Strengthens, Up About 1% This Week; Warsh Speech Raises September Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(28日)升至近兩周高點， 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)會議發表首次主題演講後，市場認為其立場偏向鷹派。華許表示，美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，交易員因此提高對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的預期。
美元本周上漲約1%，收復前一周因美國公債大幅遭拋售、引發所謂「貨幣貶值交易」而蒙受的全部跌幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.5%，報99.65，為8月18日以來最高。
聯準會主席備受期待的傑克森霍爾年度經濟政策研討會演講，涵蓋從人工智慧(AI)、前瞻指引到當前經濟狀況等議題。值得注意的是，他表示美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，並再次強調聯準會應將維持價格穩定作為政策重點。
華許演講之際，聯準會正處於複雜局面。近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上美國與伊朗似乎無休止的衝突推升油價，以及非農就業數據意外疲弱，導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部分歧加劇，3位地區聯準銀行總裁反對7月維持利率不變的決定。
華許在事先準備的講稿中表示，「截至目前，我認為勞動市場符合充分就業的狀態。但就我們的價格穩定職責而言，目前的數據更加令人擔憂。」
市場認為這場演講偏鷹，交易員提高對9月升息25個基點的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，9月升息25個基點的機率目前超過57%，高於前一天約35%。
德銀分析師Matthew Luzzetti率領團隊表示，「華許主席的演講，在對經濟與展望的具體程度，以及明顯偏鷹的立場方面，都令我們感到意外。在他的談話之後，我們認為，除非即將公布的數據大幅低於預期，否則9月升息25個基點的壓力已經落在數據上。反過來，我們仍認為聯準會今年將升息50個基點，分別在9月與12月會議升息。」
貨幣貶值交易退潮 美元回升
華許發表演講後，美國公債殖利率轉為上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期公債殖利率上升5.9個基點至4.729%，對利率較敏感的2年期公債殖利率則上升12個基點至4.352%。
近期債券市場劇烈震盪，長天期公債受到通膨疑慮、企業發債規模龐大，以及美國國債持續膨脹等因素影響而遭拋售。
美國財政部上周出人意料的干預措施，對抑制殖利率上升的效果有限。
一般來說，公債殖利率上升會產生類似升息的效果，因這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，通常有利於美元走強。但美國國債突破40兆美元的消息在上周引發市場對財政狀況的疑慮，在此環境下，投資人傾向將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
事實上，美元指數上周下跌近1%，而黃金與加密貨幣則上漲。兩者本周也持續上漲，但在美元走強情況下，漲幅明顯較小。
加幣受貿易戰拖累 本周大幅下跌
其他主要貨幣方面，本周加幣受到外匯交易員關注，在華盛頓與渥太華之間的貿易戰升溫之際，加幣下跌1%。
美加兩國上周末談判破裂後，雙方相繼對彼此加徵報復性關稅。美國總統川普周四推動將安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)。
加拿大政府周五公布數據顯示，該國經濟第二季強勁反彈，按年率計成長3.3%，明顯高於第一季經上修後的0.3%增幅。這項成長符合經濟學家預期，但遠高於加拿大央行約2.5%的預測。
日元自歷史性干預後首度觸及160
華許發表鷹派演講後，日元周五承受壓力。美元兌日元觸及160，為美日兩國7月底進行歷史性聯合干預以來首次觸及這項水準。160也曾是過去引發干預的關鍵價位。
另一方面，韓元連續第二個交易日兌美元走強，美元兌韓元匯率本周下跌約0.5%。投資人消化韓國央行(BoK)周四連續第二次會議升息的決定後，韓元走強，借貸成本也因此升至18個月高點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 28th) to near a two‑week high after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first thematic speech at the Jackson Hole conference, leading the market to view his stance as hawkish. Warsh said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved," prompting traders to raise expectations for a September Fed rate hike.
The dollar gained roughly 1% this week, recouping the entire loss it suffered last week when a sharp sell‑off in U.S. Treasuries triggered a so‑called "currency‑devaluation trade."
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.5% to 99.65, its highest level since August 18.

The highly anticipated Jackson Hole annual economic policy symposium speech by the Fed chair covered topics ranging from artificial intelligence (AI) and forward guidance to the current economic situation. Notably, he said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved" and reiterated that the Fed must keep price stability as its policy priority.

Warsh’s speech came as the Fed was navigating a complex environment. Recent inflation data remained elevated, oil prices were pushed higher by the seemingly endless U.S.–Iran conflict, and a surprisingly weak non‑farm payroll report deepened divisions within the Federal Open Market Committee, with three regional Fed presidents opposing the July decision to keep rates unchanged.
In his prepared remarks, Warsh said, "As of now, I believe the labor market is at a level of full employment. But with respect to our price‑stability mandate, the current data are more concerning."

The market interpreted the speech as hawkish, and traders lifted their expectations for a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑bp hike in September is now above 57%, up from roughly 35% the day before.

Deutsche Bank analyst Matthew Luzzetti and his team said, "Chair Warsh’s speech surprised us both in the concreteness of his economic outlook and his clearly hawkish tone. After his remarks we think the pressure for a 25‑bp hike in September now rests on the data, unless upcoming releases come in far below expectations. Conversely, we still expect the Fed to raise rates by 50 bps this year, with hikes at the September and December meetings."
Currency‑devaluation trades receded and the dollar recovered.
After Warsh’s speech, U.S. Treasury yields turned higher and bonds were sold off. The 10‑year yield rose 5.9 bp to 4.729%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12 bp to 4.352%.

Bond markets have been extremely volatile lately; long‑dated Treasuries have been sold off amid inflation concerns, a large volume of corporate issuance, and the continued expansion of U.S. sovereign debt.
The U.S. Treasury’s unexpected intervention last week had limited effect in curbing the rise in yields.

Generally, higher Treasury yields act like a rate hike by raising borrowing costs for consumers and firms, which usually supports a stronger dollar. However, news that U.S. sovereign debt surpassed $40 trillion last week sparked concerns about fiscal health, prompting investors to shift funds from fiat currencies into hard assets such as gold or cryptocurrencies—a strategy known as a "currency‑devaluation trade."
In fact, the dollar index fell almost 1% last week while gold and cryptocurrencies rose. Both assets continued to climb this week, but their gains were modest compared with the dollar’s strength.
The Canadian dollar was hit hard by the trade dispute and fell sharply this week.
Among other major currencies, the Canadian dollar drew attention from FX traders as the trade war between Washington and Ottawa heated up, leading the loonie to drop 1%.

After negotiations between the U.S. and Canada broke down over the weekend, both sides imposed retaliatory tariffs on each other. U.S. President Trump pushed on Thursday to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."

Canadian government data released on Friday showed the economy rebounded strongly in the second quarter, growing 3.3% year‑over‑year, well above the revised 0.3% gain in the first quarter. The growth matched economists’ forecasts but far exceeded the Bank of Canada’s roughly 2.5% projection.
The yen touched 160 for the first time since the historic intervention.

Following Warsh’s hawkish speech, the yen came under pressure on Friday. USD/JPY reached 160, the first time it has hit that level since the historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention at the end of July. The 160 mark has previously been a trigger for intervention.

Conversely, the Korean won strengthened against the dollar for the second consecutive trading day, with USD/KRW falling about 0.5% this week. After investors digested the Bank of Korea’s decision on Thursday to raise rates for the second consecutive meeting, the won rallied and borrowing costs rose to an 18‑month high.

items.title: 美國救日元原來是在救自己？貝森特揭背後盤算
items.title_en: Was the U.S. Really Saving the Yen to Save Itself? Bessent Reveals the Hidden Motive
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)為上月罕見出手支撐日元辯護，表示日元若出現失序波動，可能迫使投資人解除部位、衝擊全球金融市場，最終推高美國利率及家庭與企業的借貸成本。
貝森特在8月27日回覆民主黨參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)的信函中指出，日本是美債主要持有國，日元市場劇烈震盪可能引發強制平倉，進而造成全球市場動盪。他周五(28日)在社群平台X公開這封信。
美國財政部7月底與日本聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首次採取此類行動。市場觀察人士認為，貝森特之所以罕見介入匯市，除了支撐日元，也可能是為了防止日本出售美債籌措干預資金，導致美債殖利率進一步攀升。日本目前是美國公債最大的海外持有國。
貝森特沒有透露美國此次投入的具體金額，僅表示財政部動用外匯穩定基金(ESF)既有的外幣資產買進日元。他本月初曾透露，財政部在行動中使用歐元。日本財務省周五公布，政府過去一個月共投入創紀錄的964億美元支撐日元。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫先前要求貝森特說明，財政部動用ESF干預日元的分析依據及法律基礎。
貝森特回應，財政部完全遵循ESF相關法規，法律明確授權財政部長在總統批准後進行外匯交易，以維持有秩序的匯率安排。他並強調，美國並未向日本提供信貸，「日本不欠財政部任何款項，因此也不存在日本無法償還債務的風險，因為這筆債務根本不存在。」
儘管美日聯手干預一度推升日元，相關漲幅目前已部分回吐。日元周五再次跌破1美元兌160日元，為兩國協調干預當日以來首見，顯示日元貶值壓力仍未消退。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defended his rare intervention last month to support the yen, warning that a disorderly yen decline could force investors to unwind positions, shock global financial markets, and ultimately push up U.S. interest rates as well as borrowing costs for households and businesses.

In a letter to Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren dated August 27, Bessent noted that Japan is a major holder of U.S. Treasury debt and that severe yen market turbulence could trigger forced liquidations, further destabilizing global markets. He posted the letter publicly on X on Friday, the 28th.

At the end of July, the U.S. Treasury and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Market observers say Bessent’s unusual foray into the FX market was not only to prop up the yen but also to prevent Japan from selling U.S. Treasuries to raise intervention funds, which could drive Treasury yields higher. Japan remains the largest foreign holder of U.S. government bonds.

Bessent did not disclose the exact amount the United States spent, only stating that the Treasury used foreign‑currency assets from the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) to purchase yen. Earlier this month he revealed that the Treasury employed euros in the operation. Japan’s Finance Ministry announced on Friday that the government had injected a record $96.4 billion over the past month to support the yen.
Senate Banking Committee Democratic Chairman Elizabeth Warren had previously asked Bessent to explain the analytical and legal basis for the Treasury’s use of the ESF to intervene in the yen market.

Bessent responded that the Treasury fully complied with ESF statutes, which clearly authorize the Treasury Secretary, after presidential approval, to conduct foreign‑exchange transactions to maintain an orderly exchange‑rate arrangement. He emphasized that the United States has not extended any credit to Japan, saying, “Japan owes the Treasury nothing, so there is no risk of Japan being unable to repay debt because that debt simply does not exist.”

Although the joint U.S.–Japan intervention briefly lifted the yen, the gains have since been partially erased. The yen fell below ¥160 per dollar again on Friday – the first drop since the coordinated intervention – indicating that downward pressure on the currency remains.

items.title: 日本救日元殺紅眼！一個月狂砸近千億美元創紀錄
items.title_en: Japan Rescues Yen with Aggressive Intervention, Spending Nearly $100 Billion in One Month
paras: 日本政府過去一個月砸下15.4兆日元干預匯市，規模創單月歷史新高，試圖阻止日元跌破關鍵價位。此次行動更獲得美國罕見協助，成為兩國自1998年以來首度聯手買進日元，向押注日元貶值的投機者發出強烈警告。
日本財務省周五(28日)公布，7月30日至8月26日期間，政府共投入15兆3,993億日元，約合987億美元，支撐一度跌至40年低點的日元。若依不同匯率換算，金額約為964億至987億美元，無論以何種標準計算，都寫下日本單月匯市干預新紀錄。
日本今年4月至5月已耗資11.7兆日元穩定匯率，加上最新一波行動，今年投入的干預資金累計約達27兆日元。

美日聯手向空方示警

《彭博》根據日本央行數據推算，日本可能於7月30日投入約8.45兆日元，隔日再動用約5.3兆日元。日本這次特別選在央行利率決策前一天出手，打破過去通常等到央行決策或重要經濟數據公布後才行動的模式，試圖讓交易員措手不及。
日本財務大臣片山皋月與美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本月初證實，兩國於7月31日進行協調干預，這是自1998年以來，美日首度聯手買進日元。2011年兩國雖也曾合作，但當時是在日本發生強震後賣出日元，以壓低匯價並協助經濟復甦。
美國投入金額並未計入日本財務省公布的數據，實際規模預料較小，但象徵意義重大。貝森特先前甚至刻意讓媒體看到筆記本上的待辦事項，其中包括最多買進100億美元日元；相較之下，美國在1998年與2011年的干預規模僅約10億美元。
貝森特隨後在社群平台X發文，表態支持日本採取果斷的市場與貨幣政策措施，修正日元遭到大幅低估的情況。美日也表示，未來可運用外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制(FIMA Repo Facility)支援匯市行動，淡化日本因不便出售美債、干預「彈藥」可能受限的疑慮。

日元仍難擺脫貶值壓力

日元在干預前一度逼近1美元兌164日元，隨後於8月3日最高升至155.23日元，但目前已回落至159.6日元附近，吐回美日聯手干預以來逾半漲幅。市場認為，美日利差持續存在，加上投資人擔憂日本首相高市早苗的擴張性財政政策，使日元升勢受到限制。
SMBC日興證券資深利率與外匯策略師丸山倫斗表示，日本今年已投入約27兆日元，但美元兌日元仍徘徊在160附近，反映日元背後的貶值壓力依然強勁。不過，自美國出手後，市場認為官方干預資金幾乎沒有上限，因此投機性美元買盤已有所收斂。
日元目前已約4周未再觸及160關卡，顯示交易員仍忌憚政府再次進場。美國的參與及貝森特的表態，也引發日本央行可能在9月升息的揣測。市場接下來將密切關注聯準會(Fed)主席華許在傑克森霍爾央行年會的談話，以及下周美國就業報告，判斷美國是否真會升息，進而左右日元後續走勢。
paras_en: Japan has poured 15.4 trillion yen into the foreign‑exchange market over the past month, setting a record for a single‑month intervention as it tries to stop the yen from slipping below a key level. The move was bolstered by rare U.S. assistance, marking the first joint yen‑buying effort by the two countries since 1998 and sending a strong warning to speculators betting on yen depreciation.

The Ministry of Finance announced on Friday (the 28th) that between July 30 and August 26 the government deployed 15.3993 trillion yen, roughly $98.7 billion, to support a yen that had fallen to a 40‑year low. Depending on the exchange rate used, the amount ranges from about $96.4 billion to $98.7 billion, but any calculation sets a new Japanese record for monthly FX intervention.

Japan had already spent 11.7 trillion yen from April to May this year to stabilise the currency, and with the latest round the total intervention funding for the year now tops roughly 27 trillion yen.

U.S.–Japan Joint Warning to Bears Bloomberg, using Bank of Japan data, estimates that Japan may have spent about 8.45 trillion yen on July 30 and another 5.3 trillion yen the next day. Japan chose to act the day before the BOJ’s rate decision, breaking the usual pattern of waiting for a policy decision or major data release, aiming to catch traders off‑guard.

Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed earlier this month that the two nations coordinated an intervention on July 31, the first joint yen‑buying operation since 1998. In 2011 the two countries also cooperated, but then they sold yen after a major earthquake to push the exchange rate down and aid economic recovery.

The U.S. amount was not included in the Ministry’s figures; the actual scale is expected to be modest but symbolically important. Bessent even let the media see a notebook with a to‑do item to buy up to $10 billion worth of yen; by contrast, U.S. interventions in 1998 and 2011 were only about $1 billion each.

Bessent later posted on X, expressing support for Japan’s decisive market and monetary‑policy actions to correct what he called a severe undervaluation of the yen. The two countries also said they could use the Foreign‑and‑International‑Monetary‑Authorities (FIMA) Repo Facility to back future FX moves, easing concerns that Japan’s ability to intervene might be limited by its holdings of U.S. Treasuries.

The yen still faces depreciation pressure. Before the intervention it briefly approached ¥164 per $1, rose to a high of ¥155.23 on August 3, but has since slipped back to around ¥159.6, erasing more than half of the gains made since the joint action. Markets cite persistent U.S.–Japan rate differentials and worries about Prime Minister Kishida’s expansionary fiscal stance as caps on yen upside.

SMBC Nikko Securities senior rates and FX strategist Rintaro Maruyama notes that Japan has spent about ¥27 trillion this year yet the dollar‑yen pair hovers near ¥160, reflecting continued strong depreciation pressure. However, after the U.S. step‑in, markets believe official intervention funds have effectively no ceiling, tempering speculative dollar buying.

The yen has now gone roughly four weeks without testing the ¥160 barrier, showing traders still fear another government entry. U.S. participation and Bessent’s comments have also sparked speculation that the Bank of Japan may raise rates in September. Markets will watch Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s remarks at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium and next week’s U.S. jobs report to gauge whether further U.S. rate hikes are likely, which will shape the yen’s next moves.

items.title: 日美聯手救日元失靈？干預滿月回吐漲幅再度逼近160 專家：難敵巨大利差
items.title_en: US-Japan Joint Effort to Rescue the Yen Falters? Intervention’s Gains Fade as Currency Nears 160 Again, Experts Say It Can’t Overcome Massive Interest Rate Gap
paras: 日本與美國聯手出手支撐日元約一個月後，日元從約1美元兌164日元的40年低點反彈至155.23日元，但漲勢並未持續，如今再次逼近160日元。策略師表示，這次干預成功只是放緩日元短期跌勢，幾乎沒有改變導致日元長期走弱的基本因素。
日本與其他主要經濟體之間的巨大利差，仍是拖累日元的關鍵因素，這促使投資人以低成本借入日元，再將資金投向海外高收益資產。此外，日本財政前景堪憂，以及中東衝突推升油價，也進一步加重日元壓力。
道富環球投資管理公司(State Street Investment Management)資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo說：「干預處理的是市場部位，卻沒有處理油價、美國公債殖利率或美日利差。」
他指出，下一波日元持續升值，需要借助日本銀行(央行，BOJ)的貨幣正常化政策才能取得更多助力，還要配合投資人的避險資金流向行為出現改變。
隔夜指數交換合約顯示，市場目前預期日銀9月升息的機率約82%，到10月升息已幾乎完全反映在價格中。
日銀副總裁冰見野良周四(27日)發表演說時，也沒有排除下月升息的可能性。
瑞穗銀行資深策略師Masayuki Nakajima說：「由於市場已大致反映9月升息預期，若要推動日元大幅上漲，單一次政策調整恐怕還不夠。」
他表示，投資人必須相信，日本銀行後續政策正常化的步伐將比目前預期更加陡峭，日元才可能出現更強勁的升值行情。

日美官員：必要時將持續捍衛日元

美日官員已警告投資人，當局若有需要，將持續捍衛日元。日本財務大臣片山皋月曾表示，日本將利用美國聯準會(Fed)提供的一項機制，讓日本可把美國公債作為擔保借入美元，再用這些美元買進日元。
美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)也曾敦促Fed擴大這項計畫，以協助日本。根據經濟學家及市場人士分析，貝森特支持日元的主要動機，很可能是避免日元大幅貶值的衝擊蔓延至美國公債市場。
市場人士表示，如果日本當局沒有出手干預，日元可能已跌向170
因為當時市場持續加碼做空日元。
雖然干預確實放緩日元兌美元的跌勢，但日元在其他主要貨幣交叉盤的漲幅消退得更多，包括兌歐元及澳幣。
Rabobank外匯策略主管Jane Foley說：「市場顯然不相信，日本基本面足以支持目前水準以下的匯率。」
她指出，日本財務省可能希望不必再次出手干預。不過，如果9月日銀升息，干預行動可能與升息同步進行，屆時市場將提高警戒。

華許周五演說成日元下一大變數

投資人周五將密切關注Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)全球央行年會的演說，尋找有關Fed貨幣政策及美元兌日元後續走勢的線索。
Fed上月會議紀錄顯示，多名官員曾支持升息，且許多人表示，如果通膨未能下降，政策將有必要進一步緊縮。
在此同時，美元本周已從前一周近1%跌幅中略為回升。當時由於美國財政部宣布將加碼回購美債，美國公債遭遇大幅拋售，投資人採取所謂的「貨幣貶值交易」策略，導致美元壓力罩頂。
麥格理(Macquarie)全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「華許在傑克森霍爾發表結構性偏鷹派演講的可能性，高於發表鴿派演講。鴿派演講將與聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)投票者中值立場的轉變背道而馳，也會忽略其他央行釋放的鷹派訊號，甚至無視美國通膨居高不下且依然頑強的數據。」
針對日元，Sony金融集團資深分析師Kumiko Ishikawa表示，美日聯手干預確實有效讓美元兌日元走低，但市場仍懷疑這項措施能否長期抑制日元賣壓。只要市場仍預期Fed下一步是升息，即使兩國利差略為縮小，美元對投資人而言仍將具有吸引力。
paras_en: After Japan and the United States teamed up to support the yen for about a month, the currency rebounded from a 40‑year low of roughly ¥164 per $1 to ¥155.23, but the rally stalled and the yen is now edging back toward ¥160. Strategists say the intervention merely slowed the yen’s short‑term decline and did little to change the fundamental forces that have been weakening it over the long run.

The huge interest‑rate differential between Japan and other major economies remains the key drag on the yen, prompting investors to borrow yen cheaply and invest the proceeds in higher‑yielding overseas assets. In addition, Japan’s fiscal outlook is bleak and Middle‑East conflicts have pushed oil prices higher, further weighing on the yen.

Masahiko Loo, a senior fixed‑income strategist at State Street Investment Management, said: “The intervention dealt with market positioning, but it did not address oil prices, U.S. Treasury yields or the U.S.–Japan rate spread.”
He added that the next sustained yen appreciation would need to be backed by the Bank of Japan’s monetary‑normalisation policy and a shift in investors’ hedging‑fund flow behavior.
Overnight index swaps show the market currently assigns about an 82% probability to a BOJ rate hike in September, with a September hike already almost fully priced into October rates.
When BOJ Deputy Governor Hideo Hayakawa spoke on Thursday the 27th, he did not rule out the possibility of a rate hike next month.
Mitsubishi UFJ senior strategist Masayuki Nakajima said: “Since the market has largely priced in a September hike, a single policy move is unlikely to drive a big yen rally.”
He noted that investors must believe the BOJ’s subsequent normalisation will be steeper than currently expected for the yen to see a stronger appreciation trend.

Japanese and U.S. officials: Will Keep Defending the Yen If Needed. Japan’s finance minister Shunichi Suzuki has said Japan will use a mechanism provided by the Federal Reserve that allows Japan to pledge U.S. Treasuries as collateral to borrow dollars and then use those dollars to buy yen.

U.S. Treasury official Scott Bessent has also urged the Fed to expand the programme to help Japan. Analysts think Bessent’s support for the yen is likely driven by a desire to prevent a sharp yen depreciation from spilling over into the U.S. Treasury market.
Market participants say that without the intervention the yen could have fallen toward ¥170.
Because at that time the market was continuously adding short positions on the yen.
While the intervention did slow the yen’s slide against the dollar, the yen’s gains against other major currencies eroded even more, including against the euro and the Australian dollar.
Jane Foley, head of foreign‑exchange strategy at Rabobank, said: “The market clearly does not believe Japan’s fundamentals can sustain an exchange rate below the current level.”
She added that the Finance Ministry may prefer not to intervene again, but if the BOJ hikes in September, any intervention could be timed with the hike, prompting heightened market vigilance.
Investors will watch Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium on Friday for clues about Fed policy and the future path of the dollar‑yen pair.
The Fed’s minutes from last month show several officials backed a rate hike and many said further tightening would be needed if inflation does not fall.

Meanwhile, the dollar has modestly recovered this week after a near‑1% drop the previous week when the Treasury announced an expanded buy‑back of Treasuries, triggering a sharp sell‑off and a “currency‑devaluation trade” by investors that put pressure on the dollar.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said: “The odds are higher that Warsh will deliver a structurally hawkish speech at Jackson Hole than a dovish one. A dovish speech would clash with the median stance of FOMC voters and ignore hawkish signals from other central banks, as well as stubbornly high U.S. inflation data.”

Regarding the yen, Kumiko Ishikawa, senior analyst at Sony Financial Group, said the US‑Japan joint intervention did succeed in pushing the dollar‑yen lower, but markets remain skeptical about its ability to curb yen‑selling pressure over the long term. As long as the market expects the Fed’s next move to be a rate hike, even a modest narrowing of the US‑Japan spread will keep the dollar attractive to investors.

items.title: 〈台幣〉資金簇擁匯入 升8分收31.628元 連5周升值共7.3角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Gains as Funds Flood In, Rises 8 cents to 31.628, Up 7.3 cents Over Five Weeks
paras: 在資金持續匯入的態勢下，新台幣今(28)日全日處在升值格局，終場收在31.628元，升值8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值16.8億美元，已連續升值5周，累計升值7.3角。
新台幣今日以31.69元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.57元，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元強勁升值近0.7%，新台幣收升0.25%，星元和人民幣升值0.05%上下，日元貶值約0.15%，泰銖貶0.2%。
法人分析，市場持續關注聯準會貨幣政策和美債殖利率走向，目前台股透過良性輪動，展現多頭的高度韌性。
美國最新公布的經濟數據有，7月耐久財訂單月增率由 0.5%上升至 1.1%、大幅優於市場預期 0.5%，顯示投資力道強，不過，7月 PCE 年增率3.7%意外持平，反映通膨降溫情形停滯，因此，市場等待聯準會主席華許將於央行年會發表的演說內容，密切牽動股匯市變動。
paras_en: Amid continued inflows of capital, the New Taiwan dollar was in an appreciation pattern throughout the day on the 28th, closing at 31.628 per US dollar, up 8 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms recorded a turnover of US$1.68 billion, marking the fifth consecutive week of appreciation and a cumulative gain of 7.3 cents.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.69, up 1.8 cents, and peaked at 31.57 during the session, with a daily high‑low spread of 1.2 cents.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged about 0.7%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.25%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each gained roughly 0.05%, the Japanese yen weakened by about 0.15%, and the Thai baht fell 0.2%.

Analysts note that the market remains focused on the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy and U.S. Treasury yield trends. Meanwhile, Taiwan’s equity market is showing strong resilience through healthy sector rotation, reflecting bullish sentiment.

The latest U.S. economic data showed July durable goods orders rising month‑over‑month from 0.5% to 1.1%, far beating the 0.5% forecast and indicating robust investment demand. However, July’s PCE price index year‑over‑year held steady at 3.7%, suggesting that inflation cooling has stalled. Consequently, markets are awaiting remarks from Fed Chair Jerome Powell at the central bank’s annual meeting, which could heavily influence equities and currency movements.
